article.body:
ArXiv paper focuses on social pain and brain-state dynamics in adolescents with NSSI

A paper titled “Social Pain Disrupts Emotion-Action Brain-State Dynamics in Adolescents with Non-Suicidal Self-Injury” was listed on arXiv cs.AI on Oct. 8, 2026.

A CatalyzeX listing for the paper says it concerns rapid brain-state dynamics linking social distress to maladaptive behavior, which it describes as remaining unclear. The available information does not establish the study’s methods or results, so the title alone does not show how the researchers tested the proposed disruption or what evidence they found.
